snapshot.text: Fragile, largely donor- and NGO-supported system rebuilding after decades of conflict. Primary healthcare access has risen to about 65% in five years, and a new national health strategy and community health strategy aim to widen it.

priorities.title: Primary care strategy
priorities.text: A national health strategy and a new community health strategy to expand primary care.

priorities.title: Pandemic Fund project
priorities.text: Somalia launched a Pandemic Fund project to strengthen disease response.
